fullText.simplified:
第17章、师父

    叶小七用鞋刷在地上写了一个“林”字。
    “谢谢你，我知道了，你的确是个爱学习的好孩子。”包厚安说。
    藏花却问：“你没有笔吗？为什么用刷子在地上写字？”
    男孩愣了一下，回答说：“我有笔，但舍不得用。”
    藏花看了看男孩满是油污的手，说：“学习改变命运，继续努力吧！”
    说完，他开动了汽车。
    男孩站在原地，看着汽车慢慢走远。突然他想起了什么，连忙从口袋里拿出一支笔，在手心写下汽车的车牌号码，然后背起擦鞋的箱子，向另一条街飞快地跑去。
    一个小时后，包厚安回到了灰色小楼的小房间。
    油饼放在床头的小柜上，他只吃了一半。藏花讲信用，他带包厚安去买了油饼，然后再把他带了回来。
    包厚安躺在床上，闭眼在心里计算时间。
    叶小七去白林侦探社大概要半个小时。老何去警察局报警大概也是半个小时。警察根据车牌号码查找汽车主人，大概要一个小时。找到主人信息后，再上门抓人大概还要一个小时。
    现在已经过去一个小时了，如果叶小七真的明白了他的意思，如果事情顺利，那么两个小时后这座灰色的小楼就要被警察包围了。
    时间一点点过去。
    在包厚安觉得时间快到了的时候，房间外面果然传来了吵闹声。有人大声说话的声音，有东西碰撞倒地的声音，还有狗叫的声音。各种声音同时响起，吵吵闹闹了十多分钟。
    后来，包厚安在混乱中听到了一个脚步声，由远及近传来，到门口时停住，然后房间的门就被撞开了。
    光照进来，一个人站在光里，个子很高，眉眼好看，声音沉稳——“厚安！”
    包厚安立刻从床上跳了下来，激动地问：“师父？您出差回来了？”
    他不敢相信，来救他的人居然是师父白林！
    白林走过来，仔细看了看包厚安后才说：“三天前我听老何说了你的事，立刻就赶回来了。”
    “您见到那个孩子了吗？他叫叶小七！”包厚安连忙问。
    白林点头说：“见到了，那是个聪明的孩子。警察根据他给的消息，找到了藏花的汽车和这座小楼。”
    “那抓到藏花了吗？”包厚安问。
    白林说：“警察局的周局长来了，刚刚他已经抓到藏花了。”
    “太好了！我想见见藏花！”
    “嗯，我也想见见这个藏花，周局长已经把他带回去了，我们一起去警局。”
fullText.traditional:
第17章、師父

    叶小七用鞋刷在地上寫了一個“林”字。
    “謝謝你，我知道了，你的確是個愛學習的好孩子。”包厚安說。
    藏花卻問：“你沒有筆嗎？為什麼用刷子在地上寫字？”
    男孩愣了一下，回答說：“我有筆，但捨不得用。”
    藏花看了看男孩滿是油污的手，說：“學習改變命運，繼續努力吧！”
    說完，他開動了汽車。
    男孩站在原地，看著汽車慢慢走遠。突然他想起了什麼，連忙從口袋裡拿出一支筆，在手心寫下汽車的車牌號碼，然後背起擦鞋的箱子，向另一條街飛快地跑去。
    一個小時後，包厚安回到了灰色小樓的小房間。
    油餅放在床頭的小櫃上，他只吃了一半。藏花講信用，他帶包厚安去買了油餅，然後再把他帶了回來。
    包厚安躺在床上，閉眼在心裡計算時間。
    叶小七去白林偵探社大概要半個小時。老何去警察局報警大概也是半個小時。警察根據車牌號碼查找汽車主人，大概要一個小時。找到主人信息後，再上門抓人大概還要一個小時。
    現在已經過去一個小時了，如果叶小七真的明白了他的意思，如果事情順利，那麼兩個小時後這座灰色的小樓就要被警察包圍了。
    時間一點點過去。
    在包厚安覺得時間快到了的時候，房間外面果然傳來了吵鬧聲。有人大聲說話的聲音，有東西碰撞倒地的聲音，還有狗叫的聲音。各種聲音同時響起，吵吵鬧鬧了十多分鐘。
    後來，包厚安在混亂中聽到了一個腳步聲，由遠及近傳來，到門口時停住，然後房間的門就被撞開了。
    光照進來，一個人站在光裡，個子很高，眉眼好看，聲音沉穩——“厚安！”
    包厚安立刻從床上跳了下來，激動地問：“師父？您出差回來了？”
    他不敢相信，來救他的人居然是師父白林！
    白林走過來，仔細看了看包厚安後才說：“三天前我聽老何說了你的事，立刻就趕回來了。”
    “您見到那個孩子了嗎？他叫叶小七！”包厚安連忙問。
    白林點頭說：“見到了，那是個聰明的孩子。警察根據他給的消息，找到了藏花的汽車和這座小樓。”
    “那抓到藏花了嗎？”包厚安問。
    白林說：“警察局的周局長來了，剛剛他已經抓到藏花了。”
    “太好了！我想見見藏花！”
    “嗯，我也想見見這個藏花，周局長已經把他帶回去了，我們一起去警局。”

sentences.english: Bai Lin nodded and said, “I saw him. He’s a smart kid. The police found Cang Hua’s car and this house based on the information he provided.”

sentences.simplified: “那抓到藏花了吗？”包厚安问。
sentences.traditional: “那抓到藏花了嗎？”包厚安問。
sentences.pinyin: nà zhuā dào cáng huā le ma bāo hòu ān wèn
sentences.english: “Then did they catch Cang Hua?” Bao Houan asked.

sentences.simplified: 白林说：“警察局的周局长来了，刚刚他已经抓到藏花了。”
sentences.traditional: 白林說：“警察局的周局長來了，剛剛他已經抓到藏花了。”
sentences.pinyin: bái lín shuō jǐng chá jú de zhōu jú zhǎng lái le gāng gang tā yǐ jīng zhuā dào cáng huā le
sentences.english: Bai Lin said, “Police Chief Zhou from the police station came. He caught Cang Hua just now.”

sentences.simplified: “太好了！我想见见藏花！”
sentences.traditional: “太好了！我想見見藏花！”
sentences.pinyin: tài hǎo le wǒ xiǎng jiàn jiàn cáng huā
sentences.english: “Great! I want to see Cang Hua!”

sentences.simplified: “嗯，我也想见见这个藏花，周局长已经把他带回去了，我们一起去警局。”
sentences.traditional: “嗯，我也想見見這個藏花，周局長已經把他帶回去了，我們一起去警局。”
sentences.pinyin: en wǒ yě xiǎng jiàn jiàn zhè ge cáng huā zhōu jú zhǎng yǐ jīng bǎ tā dài huí qù le wǒ men yì qǐ qù jǐng jú
sentences.english: “Yes, I also want to see this Cang Hua. Police Chief Zhou has already brought him back. We’ll go to the police station together.”

sentence_translations: Chapter 17: Master
Ye Xiaoqi used the shoe brush to write the character “lin” on the ground.
“Thank you, now I see that you are indeed a good kid who loves studying,” said Bao Houan.
However, Cang Hua asked, “Don’t you have a pen? Why are you writing on the ground with a shoe brush?”
The boy was taken aback for a moment, then replied, “I have a pen, but I can’t bring myself to use it.”
Cang Hua looked at the boy’s grease-covered hands and said, “Learning changes destiny. Keep it up!”
After saying this, he started the car.
The boy stood still, watching the car slowly drive far away.
He suddenly remembered something, and hurriedly took a pen out of his pocket.
He wrote down the car’s license plate on his palm, picked up the shoe-shining box, and ran quickly toward another street.
After an hour, Bao Houan returned to the small room inside the grey house.
The deep-fried dough cakes were placed on the small cabinet by the bed. He only ate half.
Cang Hua kept his word. He took Bao Houan to buy deep-fried dough cakes and then brought him back.
Bao Houan lay down on the bed, closed his eyes, and mentally calculated the time.
It would take Ye Xiaoqi about half an hour to get to the Bai Lin Detective Agency.
It would also take Old He about half an hour to get to the police station and inform the police.
It would take the police about one hour to find the owner of the car according to the license plate number.
It would then take the police about another hour to come and make the arrest after finding the owner’s information.
An hour had already passed.
If Ye Xiaoqi really understood what he meant and if things went smoothly, ..
.. then this grey house would be surrounded by the police in two hours.
Time passed little by little.
Just when Bao Houan felt that the time had almost arrived, sure enough, a noise came from outside the room.
There were sounds of people talking loudly, things colliding and falling to the ground, and dogs barking.
Various sounds rang out at the same time, creating a loud noise for more than ten minutes.
Later, Bao Houan heard the sound of footsteps amidst the chaos.
The footsteps came closer, stopping when they reached the door. Then the door to the room burst open.
Light streamed in, and a person stood in the light. He was very tall, good-looking, and had a calm voice: “Houan!”
Bao Houan immediately jumped down from the bed and asked excitedly, “Master? You’ve returned from your business trip?”
He couldn’t believe that the person who came to his rescue turned out to be Master Bai Lin!
Bai Lin came over, looked carefully at Bao Houan, and then said, ..
.. “I heard about your situation from Old He three days ago, and I rushed back immediately.”
“Did you see that kid? His name is Ye Xiaoqi!” Bao Houan asked hurriedly.
Bai Lin nodded and said, “I saw him. He’s a smart kid. The police found Cang Hua’s car and this house based on the information he provided.”
“Then did they catch Cang Hua?” Bao Houan asked.
Bai Lin said, “Police Chief Zhou from the police station came. He caught Cang Hua just now.”
“Great! I want to see Cang Hua!”
“Yes, I also want to see this Cang Hua. Police Chief Zhou has already brought him back. We’ll go to the police station together.”
